title: ION Trade Offer Schema Pack v1
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for the ION trade/offer/v1 schema pack. Root resolves to IONTradeOffer, which inherits directly from Beckn RetailOffer and combines generic trade offer mechanics with explicitly marked Indonesia-specific extensions.

IONTradeOffer.title: IONTradeOffer
IONTradeOffer.description: ION trade offer attributes. Inherits directly from RetailOffer v2.1 and combines generic trade offer mechanics with Indonesia-specific policy, language, logistics-pricing, and payment-method extensions. Properties originating in the former ION-specific layer are identified by x-attr-ion-layer: ion.

policyRef.description: ION standard cancellation policy IRI. cancel.prepacked.free: buyer may cancel before packed at no fee. cancel.mto.nofee.before_prepare: MTO, free cancellation before preparation starts. cancel.none: no cancellation permitted after confirm.
ION standard return policy IRI. Encodes window duration and who pays return shipping.

ION standard dispute resolution policy IRI. dispute.consumer.bpsk: B2C — BPSK (Badan Penyelesaian Sengketa Konsumen). dispute.commercial.bani: B2B — BANI arbitration. dispute.commercial.odr: Online Dispute Resolution via ION platform.

ION Grievance SLA policy IRI. Declares response time, resolution time, escalation path, and penalty consequences when SLA is breached. Subject to marketplace minimum (grievance.sla.standard) for B2C; marketplace-operated BAPs may enforce stricter policies on their sellers. ION timer auto-escalates when SLAs are breached — no manual action needed.

Payment terms policy IRI. Declares when payment is collected, which methods are accepted, whether deposit or credit terms apply, and what the late-payment penalty is if applicable. Must be compatible with the order's paymentRail and collectedBy.
policyRef.x-ion-regulatory: UU 7/2021 HPP; OJK POJK terkait metode pembayaran

policyRef.description: Penalty policy IRI. Normally inferred from seller's onboarding tier (Standard/Mall/Premium) and other declared policies (return, cancellation, grievance-sla). May be declared explicitly for per-offer overrides. Sellers cannot select a penalty policy weaker than their tier minimum.
policyRef.$comment: x-ion-condition: Auto-derived from seller tier and other policies; declare only for an explicit override

allowedReasons.description: Seller-declared reasons for which cancellation is accepted when the inherited cancellation policy allows cancellation.
allowedReasons.$comment: x-ion-condition: Required when policies.cancellation.allowed is true

evidenceRequirement.description: Evidence required from buyer when initiating a return. VIDEO_UNBOXING_REQUIRED is standard for high-value electronics. PHYSICAL_INSPECTION is used for high-value items (>IDR 10M) where seller sends inspector before accepting return.

evidenceMinPhotos.description: Minimum number of evidence photos required.
evidenceMinPhotos.$comment: x-ion-condition: Required when policies.returns.evidenceRequirement includes PHOTO

timeToShip.description: Time from order confirm to when seller hands package to logistics. ISO 8601 duration.

selfPickupOtp.description: Whether OTP verification is required when consumer picks up order. If true, BPP generates deliveryOtp in performanceAttributes.

selfPickupInstructions.description: Instructions for self-pickup — counter number, floor, collection point.
selfPickupInstructions.example: Ambil di counter F&B lantai 1, tunjukkan kode pesanan Anda.

proofOfDeliveryType.description: Type of delivery confirmation proof required.

contactDetailsConsumerCare.description: Structured consumer-care contact displayed for pre- and post-purchase support.

offerType.description: Commercial offer mechanic. AUCTION identifies bid-based offers; FLASH_SALE identifies time- or quantity-limited sale events.

priceModel.description: How pricing is determined for this offer.

minBasketAmount.description: Minimum basket value in IDR for offer to be valid.

maxDiscountAmount.description: Maximum discount cap in IDR for percentage offers.

voucherCode.description: Voucher or promo code to activate offer.

usageLimitPerUser.description: Maximum times this offer can be used by a single user.

customerSegment.description: Segment of customers eligible for this offer.

priceChangeSchedule.description: Price validity timeline for a campaign. Use one entry for a single price window and multiple entries when the price changes during the campaign. BAPs MUST render countdown UI and compute the correct price at transaction time. Entries MUST NOT overlap and must be sorted ascending by validFrom.

priceValue.description: IDR amount valid in this window

phaseLabel.description: Human label e.g. "Jam pertama harga hemat"

reservationWindowSeconds.description: Seconds for which the BPP will hold availability and the on_select price quote. Default 300. BPP soft-reserves at on_select, hard-reserves at on_init. After window expires, availability is released and any subsequent /confirm for this messageId returns ION-3006.

totalStockCap.description: Absolute total quantity available under this offer. When reached, all subsequent /select calls return ION-3008. Distinct from resource.availability.maxOrderQty (per-order cap).

perUserQuantityCap.description: Maximum units a single buyer can purchase under this offer across all transactions (enforced by BPP). Distinct from usageLimitPerUser which is number of separate redemptions.

queueEnabled.description: Whether BPP uses a queue/throttle mechanism when demand exceeds supply. When true, on_select may return queuePosition.

queuePosition.description: Consumer's current position in the purchase queue. 0 = at front. Returned in on_select when queueEnabled=true.

estimatedWaitSeconds.description: Estimated wait time before this consumer reaches front of queue.
estimatedWaitSeconds.$comment: x-ion-condition: Returned in on_select when queuePosition is present

stackingGroup.description: Voucher stacking group. Vouchers from different groups stack by default. Within a single group only one voucher can apply per order unless stackingRules override.

stackingRules.description: Explicit voucher stacking rules. Used when offer has complex combination logic beyond the default group rules.

mustCombineWith.description: Offer IDs that must also be applied for this offer to activate.

cannotCombineWith.description: Offer IDs with which this offer cannot be combined.

maxDiscountWhenStacked.description: Cap on total discount when multiple offers stack (IDR).

codEligibilityForBuyer.description: BPP-evaluated COD eligibility for the specific buyer in this transaction. Returned in on_select. Distinct from paymentConstraints.codAvailable which is offer-level availability. Allows BPP to decline COD for new buyers, previous COD failures, high-value items exceeding buyer's verified tier, etc.

codEligibilityReason.$comment: x-ion-condition: Required when codEligibilityForBuyer is declared

customTermsAddendum.description: Free-text addendum for edge cases (e.g. watchmaker offering lifetime service). Supplements the declared policy IRIs but cannot contradict them. If addendum contradicts base policy, base policy wins and addendum is informational only. BAP displays addendum below the structured policy terms.
customTermsAddendum.example: Garansi seumur hidup untuk mekanisme jam tangan mewah (terms & conditions apply - see seller page).

handlingTime.description: Time from order confirmation until the package is ready for logistics. Used for custom-print, made-to-measure, and pre-order merchandise.

displayLanguage.description: Languages in which this offer's catalog content is available.
displayLanguage.x-ion-regulatory: ION Network Policy — language completeness validation
displayLanguage.$comment: x-ion-condition: Must include id; cross-border offers must also include en

weightSlabs.description: Weight-based pricing tiers for catalogued logistics offers.
weightSlabs.$comment: x-ion-condition: Required for catalogued domestic logistics patterns

paymentMethodEligibility.description: Structured ION payment-method restrictions applied in addition to inherited acceptedPaymentMethod.

minAmount.description: Minimum order value in IDR for this method to be eligible

maxAmount.description: Maximum order value in IDR (BI cap for QRIS is 10M)

requiresBuyerTier.description: Buyer tier(s) eligible for this method

requiresAddressVerification.description: Whether buyer must have a verified delivery address

requiresPhoneVerification.description: Whether the buyer must have a verified phone number.

excludedCategories.description: Category codes excluded from this method

requiredBnplProvider.$comment: x-ion-condition: Applicable only when method is BNPL
